# Nichekala — Architecture & Interior Design Studio

> Nichekala is a Chennai-based architecture and interior design studio creating purposeful homes, pocket homes, commercial spaces, and heritage conservation projects. Our practice balances aesthetics, functionality, and contextual sensitivity — design that fits how you live, not the other way around.

**Studio**: Nichekala Architecture and Design Studio (legal entity: Nichekala Designs Private Limited)
**Location**: 283, Mohanram Nagar, Mogappair West, Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India
**Phone**: +91-9600156838
**Email**: info@nichekala.in
**Instagram**: [@nichekala_official](https://www.instagram.com/nichekala_official/)

## Services

- **Architecture** — residential, commercial, and recreational buildings
- **Interior Design** — full-service interior design for homes and businesses
- **Pocket Home Design** — compact, smart-living homes for small footprints
- **Heritage Conservation** — restoration and adaptive reuse of heritage structures
- **Creative Consulting** — branding, advertising, and design direction

## Editorial / Insights

The blog covers interior design trends in Chennai, eco-friendly and budget-friendly home design, pocket-home strategies, balcony gardens, kitchen utility, ambient vs accent lighting, flooring trade-offs, gender-neutral spaces, and pre-project client questionnaires.

See: [Top Architectural Design Trends](https://nichekala.in/blogs/top-architectural-design-trends), [Top Interior Trends in Chennai](https://nichekala.in/blogs/top-interior-trends-in-chennai), [Mastering the Art of Interior Design](https://nichekala.in/blogs/mastering-the-art-of-interior-design), [Eco-Friendly Home Design in Chennai](https://nichekala.in/blogs/eco-friendly-home-design-in-chennai).

## Service area

Primarily Chennai and Tamil Nadu, with select projects across India (e.g., Goa).
